lines.zh: 喉咙里咕噜一声，我来了。
lines.en: A gurgle in my throat, and here I come.

lines.zh: 用触手感受周围的动静
绿光贴着岩壁，一寸寸挪。
lines.en: Green light slides along the wall, inch by inch.
My spines scrape the tunnel, hissing.

lines.zh: 我在暗处爬行，泥土塌在身后。
lines.en: I crawl in the dark, earth falling behind me.

lines.zh: 地底的土腥味让我安心。
lines.en: The smell of deep earth calms me.

lines.zh: 地底的绿光灭了，我转向你。
lines.en: The green glow dies; I turn to you.

lines.zh: 盯着你的眼睛，地下的镐声停了。
lines.en: Eyes on yours, and the digging below falls silent.

lines.zh: 地下的镐声停了，我找到你。
lines.en: The pickaxe below stopped — I have found you.

lines.zh: 地下的空气，我嗅到生人。
lines.en: In this underground air I smell a stranger.

lines.zh: 我把你的每一次抬手都记下。
lines.en: I note every lift of your hand.

lines.zh: 我用绿光的眼，盯住你的镐。
lines.en: With my green-lit eye I fix on your pick.

lines.zh: 疼得我背刺都蜷了起来！
lines.en: The pain curls every spine on my back!

lines.zh: 绿光一暗，我的刺折了两根！
lines.en: My green glow dims; two spines are snapped!

lines.zh: 我的血滴在土里，土在冒烟。
lines.en: My blood drips into the soil and the soil smokes.

lines.zh: 阿勒米特锭从我身上滚落。
lines.en: Arlemite ingots roll off my body.

lines.zh: 你的味道比食物还诱人。
lines.en: Your taste is more alluring than food.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我会给你美味。
lines.en: You can't escape, I'll make a meal of you.

lines.zh: 我必须品尝你，我需要力量。
lines.en: I must taste you, I need strength.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，只有你散发着光芒。
我来了，享受你的味道吧。
味道就是力量，你尝尝吧。

lines.en: You're in my way, are you suicidal?

lines.zh: 别靠近我，你活不了多久。
lines.en: Stay back, you won't last long.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我要教训你。
lines.en: You blocked my path, I'll teach you a lesson.

lines.zh: 别想靠近我，我很快就会吃掉你。
lines.en: Don't think you can get close, I'll eat you soon.

lines.zh: 你触碰了我的领域，求死吧。
躲开我，否则你会后悔的。
lines.en: Get out of my way, or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我要让你消失。
lines.en: You blocked my way, I'll make you vanish.

lines.zh: 离我远点，否则后果自负。
lines.en: Stay away, or face the consequences.

lines.zh: 别靠近我，否则你会后悔的。
lines.en: Don't come closer, you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我要你消失。
lines.en: You blocked my path, I'll make you disappear.
Mate with me, let life continue.

lines.zh: 我在这里等你，做我的伴侣。
lines.en: I'll wait here for you, be my partner.

lines.zh: 让我与你共生，共享生命。
lines.en: Let me share life with you.
Live and die with me, without regret.

lines.zh: 我感到一股腐化的力量在召唤我！
lines.en: Feel the corrupting power calling to me!

lines.zh: 腐化的能量在我的刺中涌动！
黑暗中，我等待着猎物的到来！
lines.en: In the dark, I wait for prey.

lines.zh: 猎人们无法逃脱我的利刺！
lines.en: My sharp spines ensure no escape.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤覆盖着腐败的印记！
在这片黑暗中，我是唯一的光明！
lines.en: In this darkness, I am the light.

lines.zh: 我在这片腐化的土地上生长！
lines.en: I grow in this corrupted land.
My spines are tools of darkness.

lines.zh: 我找到了我的下一个目标！

lines.en: Let my spines leave a mark!

lines.zh: 洞只有一条路，我在尽头等你。
lines.en: The tunnel has one way out, and I wait at its end.

lines.zh: 我会享受撕裂你的痛苦！

lines.en: In the dark, you lit yourself up.
A scent from the surface. Fresh.
I know these tunnels better than you.
Something living is digging my burrow.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尖刺范围了。
lines.en: You stepped into my spines' reach.
The moss shuddered. It is you.

lines.zh: 尖刺全部立起，我冲过去！
lines.en: Every spine rises; I rush in!

lines.zh: 我的刺即将穿透你的心脏！
lines.en: My spines will pierce your heart!

lines.zh: 感受我的利刺带来的痛苦！
lines.en: Feel the pain of my sharp spines!

lines.zh: 洞壁上的影子，全是我的刺。
lines.en: Every shadow on the cave wall is one of my spines.

lines.zh: 我的力量将使你化为尘土！
lines.en: My power will reduce you to dust!
Each of my spines is deadly!

lines.zh: 别往后退，那里是我的洞。
lines.en: Do not back up; that is my burrow.
My spines are already aimed at you.

lines.zh: 你挖下的土堵死了退路。
lines.en: The soil you dug blocks your way out.
Down here, you keep your head low.
Green light dances on your face.
One more step and it goes through you.
The rock under you is splitting.
I am at the end of the hole you dug.
Rips through the darkness towards you
Rips at your arm with its claws
Stabs at you with its spines
Bares its teeth and bites you
A spine punches into your calf.
Green light flashes; I bite down.
My spines go through the shield.
A tainted claw pins you down.
My tail spike sweeps; you stumble back.
Have you heard the sound in my throat?

lines.zh: 我这一撞，把你顶进岩壁。
lines.en: My charge slams you into the wall.

lines.zh: 腐化的碎片留在伤口里。
lines.en: Corrupted shards stay in the wound.

lines.zh: 咬一口，尝尝腐化的滋味。
lines.en: One bite, and you taste the taint.
A fissure opens; green light crawls out.
Beneath the stone, I turn over.

lines.zh: 火燎过我甲刺，焦味充满洞穴。
lines.en: Fire scorches my spines; the cave fills with the stench.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶摔下，尖刺折了几根。
lines.en: I fall from the cave roof and break several spines.
There is no water down here. Help!
Nothing to eat in these tunnels...

lines.zh: 雷光顺着甲刺钻进肉里。
